title: Radiant Nuclear
description: Warm industrial calm: a paper-cream page, soft charcoal type, one clear teal for small markers, and a sandy tan band with white type. One geometric-humanist sans in bold caps for every heading, square corners everywhere, flat translucent dark buttons, a fixed 24px gutter.
notes: light is the faithful mode; dark is a night-plant sibling (warm charcoal page, deep tan band, brighter teal)
Nunito Sans stands in for Avenir Next LT Pro (closed)
secondary is the tan band with white text, not a light surface
radius is 0: every corner is square
the gutter is 24px at every width and the page runs up to 2000px wide
